current_deployment:
# The Deployment currently running in namespace "platform" (hand-submitted
# manifest; in real life this comes from `kubectl get deploy -o yaml`).
# Its selector is identical to what the v3 chart renders, so the rehearsal
# accepts it. The image still runs the old version.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: platform-rel-payment-web
  namespace: platform
  labels:
    helm.sh/chart: payment-web-2.0.0
    app.kubernetes.io/name: payment-web
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: platform-rel
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "4.0.0"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
  annotations:
    checksum/legacy: fixed-2026-11-23
  resourceVersion: "1234567"
  uid: 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555
  generation: 7
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: payment-web
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: platform-rel
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: payment-web
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: platform-rel
      annotations:
        checksum/legacy: fixed-2026-11-23
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: false
        runAsUser: 0
      nodeSelector:
        disktype: hdd
      initContainers:
        - name: config-bootstrap
          image: "registry.local/frontend/payment-web:3.0.7-patch.2"
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "echo bootstrap"]
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: platform-rel-payment-web-config
      containers:
        - name: payment-web
          image: "registry.local/frontend/payment-web:3.0.7-patch.2"
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 300m
              memory: 256Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 64Mi
          env:
            - name: CACHE_TTL
              value: "60"
            - name: API_BASE
              value: "https://api.example.com"
            - name: CHART_MAJOR
              value: "2"
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: platform-rel-payment-web-config
            # External, chart does not render it: must be kept as-is.
            - configMapRef:
                name: platform-shared-config
            - configMapRef:
                name: payment-web-optional-flags
                optional: true
          volumeMounts:
            - name: app-config-volume
              mountPath: /etc/app-config
              readOnly: true
            - name: feature-flags
              mountPath: /etc/feature-flags
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: app-config-volume
          configMap:
            name: platform-rel-payment-web-config
            items:
              - key: cacheTtl
                path: cache-ttl.conf
              - key: apiBase
                path: api-base.conf
        - name: feature-flags
          configMap:
            name: payment-web-optional-flags
            optional: true
